name: Burrow
notes: The plain building; unlimited (a cap of 5 bound: the buildings lane collapsed). Clay comes free from any shore hex; you pay the tolls.

name: Logging camp
rules: Forest only. A wood source that never runs out: others pay you 1 for each wood they haul from it.
notes: Stage 2 (brainstorm-stage-2-3.md 6.3). Never runs out; two per player.

name: Quarry
rules: Hills with stone only. A stone source that never runs out: others pay you 1 for each stone they haul from it.
notes: Stone is the late resource: dearer to haul (stoneBankToll). Needs nothing (needing wood, almost none were built).

name: Wharf
rules: Needs 2+ canals on its borders. When built, 1 money per canal on its borders.
notes: Rewards busy junctions. Never VP per canal: digging must not raise the Dig lane's own multiplicand (scoring.md).

name: Inn
rules: +1 VP at game end per building next to it, anyone's, up to +3.
notes: A late, inland building: needs stone. Cap 3 (was 2): it sat at its cap.

name: Mill
rules: 1 VP, and +1 more income (+2 in all).
notes: One less income than stage 1: income ran high (14 at the end).

name: Lock
rules: Needs 3+ canals on its borders. Every haul by another player through a canal on its borders pays you 1, from the bank.
notes: The toll house: rewards owning a junction without making others' builds dearer (brainstorm 6.3).
